name: Dozzle
description: A live log viewer for Docker containers. It needs the Docker socket read-only, which is a real grant of access to every container on this host.

access.note: Dozzle starts with no account. A brand-new install offers a setup wizard that creates one, and it stays open for fifteen minutes after the first start and never again — so open the address as soon as the deployment is ready. Until that account exists, anyone who reaches the address reads the logs of every container on this host.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Anyone who reaches this reads every container's logs. Restrict it at the proxy.

volumes.name: socket
volumes.purpose: Read-only access to the Docker daemon

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The account the setup wizard creates, and saved settings

update.notes: Dozzle keeps its account and settings in the data volume.

security.reason: Reading container logs requires the Docker socket. It is mounted read-only, and anything that can read the socket can enumerate every container on this host.
